description: Shared preset: track `# renovate:`-annotated *_IMAGE and *_VERSION entries under `variables:` in .gitlab-ci.yml. The gitlabci manager reads only job and global `image:` keys, so a variable (CI_IMAGE, CI_BASE_IMAGE, NODE_IMAGE, WRANGLER_VERSION) is invisible without this. Extend with `local>example-org/renovate:ci-variables`.

customManagers.description: Annotated *_IMAGE variables holding `<repo>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>`. The `\S*?:` prefix consumes `<repo>:` (variables such as $HARBOR_HOST included), so currentValue is only the tag and autoreplace rewrites tag and digest while leaving the repo intact.
Annotated *_VERSION variables holding a plain version (a CLI run through npx, for example). Versioning follows the datasource.
